entities.name: Pătraşcu cel Bun
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pătrașcu the Good, was a ruler of the principality of Wallachia, between 1554 and 24 December 1557, one of many rulers of Wallachia during the 16th century. A member of the House of Drăculești, he was the son of Radu Paisie.
